answer: Reputation Decay Escrow. Each identity accrues a public escrow balance that rises with successful transactions and decays exponentially during inactivity; crossing a low horizon triggers throttled access to high-value work. An attacker must fund every clone continuously to keep it above threshold, and cloning multiplies that ongoing cost linearly. Honest agents pay once and coast on earned balance. The oasis of profitable work shrinks for mass-produced identities, while a single opal of verified history buys durable standing.
